faq.a: Elnur is associated with the Arabic form إِلْنُور, whose core sense is elnur; light of the faith (azerbaijani form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Elnur?
faq.a: Elnur is associated with Arabic. Elnur is the Azerbaijani form of Arabic النُّور (al-Nūr), meaning 'the light'; it occurs in the Quran.
Yes — the underlying form إِلْنُور is Arabic.
Elnur can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Elnur should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Al-Nūr occurs in the Quran as a term for light and a surah name.

faq.q: What does Elnur mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Elnur is rendered النور and carries the sense النور، روشنی.

faq.q: What does Elnur mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Elnur is rendered النور and carries the sense النور، نور.
A romanized syllable approximation is el-nur. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Elnur?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Elnur, elnur. Script forms are إِلْنُور, النور, एलनूर.

faq.q: Is Elnur a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
